user.title: Skylight Family Display
user.description: Adds a Skylight panel to the sidebar. Family members, calendars, chores, meals, lists and photos are all managed from inside the panel.

init.title: Skylight settings PIN
init.description: {status} Tick the box and submit to remove the settings PIN, for example if it was forgotten. Anyone can then set a new PIN from Skylight → Settings.
